
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/mchao/p/19723423" title="发布于 2026-03-16 10:18">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">为什么 Agent 一定要“思考→行动→观察”？聊聊 ReAct 循环</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<div class="lake-content">
<h1 id="OLFq0"><span class="ne-text">如果我们看过一些 Agent 框架，比如：</span></h1>
<ul class="ne-ul">
<li id="u65b390f2" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">LangChain</span></li>
<li id="u4b248f7f" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">AutoGen</span></li>
<li id="u4d4cd473" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">CrewAI</span></li>
</ul>
<p id="u2000561f" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">可能会发现一个有点奇怪的现象。</span></p>
<p id="u020abc77" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">这些框架看起来功能很多：</span></p>
<ul class="ne-ul">
<li id="ucc95249c" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">Tool 调用</span></li>
<li id="u72b5a4df" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">Memory</span></li>
<li id="ud1327f57" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">多 Agent 协作</span></li>
<li id="u195cbb09" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">任务规划</span></li>
</ul>
<p id="u4044d821" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">但如果真的去翻源码或者架构，我们会发现一个事实：</span></p>
<p id="u85e62814" class="ne-p"><strong>很多 Agent 系统的核心逻辑其实非常简单。</strong></p>
<p id="ub52fdbe5" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">大多数框架，本质上都在实现同一个循环：</span></p>
<pre class="ne-codeblock language-plain" data-language="plain"><code>思考 → 行动 → 观察 → 再思考</code></pre>
<p id="ufb0be37a" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">也就是所谓的 <strong>ReAct（ Reasoning + Acting ）</strong><span class="ne-text">。</span></span></p>
<p id="u92199c37" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">第一次看到这个结构的时候，我其实有点意外。<br><span class="ne-text">因为它简单得有点不像一个“AI 架构”。</span></span></p>
<p id="u3bb75358" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">但后来越看越发现：<br><strong>几乎所有 Agent 系统，都离不开这个循环。</strong></span></p>
<p id="u23bc52ec" class="ne-p"><img src="https://cdn.nlark.com/yuque/0/2026/jpeg/503577/1773625313825-456fe65f-2e34-427d-b6dd-3cba6f783055.jpeg" width="500" id="ue2fe283a" class="ne-image" title=""></p>
<hr id="VstTc" class="ne-hr">
<h1 id="HF3we"><span class="ne-text">为什么复杂任务必须“分步骤做”</span></h1>
<p id="u32fa3b31" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">先说一个很基础的问题。</span></p>
<p id="u0695a6fd" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">大模型本身其实只会做一件事：</span></p>
<div class="ne-quote">
<p id="ueead845f" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">根据输入生成一段文本。</span></p>

</div>
<p id="u6321b8d4" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">比如用户问：</span></p>
<pre class="ne-codeblock language-plain" data-language="plain"><code>帮我总结一下 AI Agent 的技术趋势</code></pre>
<p id="u2ed91f49" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">模型可以直接生成一段总结。</span></p>
<p id="u488d8070" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">但如果任务变复杂一点，比如：</span></p>
<pre class="ne-codeblock language-plain" data-language="plain"><code>写一份 AI Agent 行业分析报告</code></pre>
<p id="uc9de4532" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">这件事情如果是人来做，一般不会一步完成。</span></p>
<p id="ua036f382" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">大多数人会这样做：</span></p>
<ol class="ne-ol">
<li id="uf4efaa6b" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">先去搜索一些资料</span></li>
<li id="u67cf9552" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">找几篇文章或报告看一看</span></li>
<li id="u5373af00" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">整理出几个关键观点</span></li>
<li id="u425fbcb8" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">想好文章结构</span></li>
<li id="u82690dc9" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">最后再写成一份完整报告</span></li>
</ol>
<p id="u8f549bc2" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">我们会发现，这其实是一个<strong>多步骤过程</strong><span class="ne-text">。</span></span></p>
<p id="u40a5989d" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">每一步都在决定：<br><strong>下一步该做什么。</strong></span></p>
<p id="u20c4f156" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">问题就在这里。</span></p>
<p id="u6f302fea" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">普通的大模型并不会自动拆分这些步骤，它只会根据当前输入生成一个结果。</span></p>
<p id="uf9bf03e9" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">但现实世界的大多数任务，其实都是一种 <strong>连续决策过程</strong><span class="ne-text">。</span></span></p>
<p id="u1c707301" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">所以如果想让 AI 真的去“完成任务”，就必须给它一种机制，让它可以：</span></p>
<ul class="ne-ul">
<li id="u3f471c4c" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">一步一步思考</span></li>
<li id="ua20c5f15" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">在过程中调用工具</span></li>
<li id="uc2fb2d50" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">根据结果调整下一步动作</span></li>

</ul>
<p id="u351d871a" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">这就是 ReAct 想解决的问题。<br><img src="https://cdn.nlark.com/yuque/0/2026/jpeg/503577/1773624894383-340e5419-0c1f-4401-9724-f01dec2db11e.jpeg" width="400" id="ud60358b9" class="ne-image" title=""></span></p>
<hr id="v93Eq" class="ne-hr">
<h1 id="VyVDb"><span class="ne-text">ReAct：其实就是把“思考”和“行动”串起来</span></h1>
<p id="u56759cee" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">ReAct 这个概念来自一篇论文：</span></p>
<p id="u2798a705" class="ne-p"><strong>ReAct: Synergizing Reasoning and Acting in Language Models</strong></p>
<p id="u08b53e54" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">这篇论文的想法其实很简单：</span></p>
<p id="u1401ae26" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">让模型在推理过程中，不只是输出最终答案，而是同时输出三种信息：</span></p>
<pre class="ne-codeblock language-plain" data-language="plain"><code>Thought（思考）
Action（行动）
Observation（观察结果）</code></pre>
<p id="uf4673b92" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">例如：</span></p>
<pre class="ne-codeblock language-plain" data-language="plain"><code>Thought: 需要先查一下最新的 Agent 技术趋势
Action: search("AI Agent trend 2025")
Observation: 返回搜索结果</code></pre>
<p id="u16da895e" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">然后继续：</span></p>
<pre class="ne-codeblock language-plain" data-language="plain"><code>Thought: 需要整理这些资料
Action: summarize(content)
Observation: 得到总结</code></pre>
<p id="ufecdeed1" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">整个过程看起来大概是这样：</span></p>
<pre class="ne-codeblock language-plain" data-language="plain"><code>Thought → Action → Observation
            ↑
            └──── 再回到 Thought</code></pre>
<p id="udc890cde" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">换句话说，模型不再是“一次回答完问题”，而是在执行过程中不断调整下一步动作。</span></p>
<p id="ude842780" class="ne-p"><img src="https://cdn.nlark.com/yuque/0/2026/png/503577/1773626848026-7db83d79-9f56-4ed4-b04f-4cbdbf3b8954.png" width="500" id="u923754ef" class="ne-image" title=""></p>
<hr id="CbjjP" class="ne-hr">
<h1 id="Ftrxu"><span class="ne-text">从工程角度看，它其实就是一个循环</span></h1>
<p id="u02f0b252" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">如果用程序员的视角来看，ReAct 其实没那么神秘。</span></p>
<p id="ud2bd3c41" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">它本质上就是一个循环。</span></p>
<p id="uc1d12dd8" class="ne-p"><img src="https://cdn.nlark.com/yuque/0/2026/jpeg/503577/1773624987748-4dc254ab-5367-4496-b74a-759a057e2432.jpeg" width="461" id="bMEKq" class="ne-image" title=""></p>
<p id="uf6bc0959" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">伪代码甚至可以写得很简单：</span></p>
<pre class="ne-codeblock language-plain" data-language="plain"><code>while (task_not_finished)
{
    thought = LLM(reasoning)

    action = choose_tool(thought)

    observation = run_tool(action)

    update_context(observation)
}</code></pre>
<p id="u18c0d138" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">模型负责做一件事：</span></p>
<pre class="ne-codeblock language-plain" data-language="plain"><code>决定下一步要做什么</code></pre>
<p id="ue50e2d65" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">系统负责做另一件事：</span></p>
<pre class="ne-codeblock language-plain" data-language="plain"><code>执行工具
拿到结果
把结果再喂给模型</code></pre>
<p id="u7c683839" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">整个系统就可以不断运行，直到任务完成。</span></p>
<p id="ud54511c9" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">很多 Agent 框架，其实只是把这个循环封装得更好用而已。</span></p>
<hr id="XQ5vq" class="ne-hr">
<h1 id="Y42ca"><span class="ne-text">为什么这个循环这么关键</span></h1>
<p id="ub6cc8dfb" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">这个循环真正解决的问题其实只有一个：</span></p>
<p id="ud9992208" class="ne-p"><strong>让 AI 在执行过程中可以不断修正自己的决策。</strong></p>
<p id="ub2e2bf3d" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">举个简单例子。</span></p>
<p id="udd1cfa85" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">如果用户说：</span></p>
<pre class="ne-codeblock language-plain" data-language="plain"><code>查一下最近最火的 AI Agent 框架</code></pre>
<p id="ua5179f8a" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">Agent 可能会这样工作：</span></p>
<p id="u49533363" class="ne-p"><img src="https://cdn.nlark.com/yuque/0/2026/jpeg/503577/1773625010806-bc933575-9781-4678-bf8e-fe05e7c1010d.jpeg" width="500" id="JtCZr" class="ne-image" title=""></p>
<p id="udce45d2e" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">第一步：</span></p>
<pre class="ne-codeblock language-plain" data-language="plain"><code>Thought: 需要先搜索
Action: search("AI Agent framework")</code></pre>
<p id="udd0c8db3" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">第二步：</span></p>
<pre class="ne-codeblock language-plain" data-language="plain"><code>Observation: 得到搜索结果
Thought: 需要整理这些框架
Action: summarize()</code></pre>
<p id="u0bedd878" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">第三步：</span></p>
<pre class="ne-codeblock language-plain" data-language="plain"><code>Observation: 得到总结
Thought: 可以输出最终结果</code></pre>
<p id="uc73578ea" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">这个过程其实和人做事情很像。</span></p>
<p id="ud16d94e9" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">先找信息，再整理信息，最后给出结果。</span></p>
<p id="u3bfbf0c5" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">如果没有这个循环，模型只能一次性生成一个答案，很难处理中间过程。</span></p>
<hr id="H9K98" class="ne-hr">
<h1 id="GiLvV"><span class="ne-text">放到设备控制系统里，这个循环会更明显</span></h1>
<p id="ufd6fe8cf" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">在我们做的一个工业控制系统里，这个循环其实非常直观。</span></p>
<p id="ua1af33ed" class="ne-p"><img src="https://cdn.nlark.com/yuque/0/2026/jpeg/503577/1773625037631-54e25e19-ad45-44e5-95bf-bdddd900c161.jpeg" width="500" id="TdXIT" class="ne-image" title=""></p>
<p id="u6aa3f286" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">假设用户输入：</span></p>
<pre class="ne-codeblock language-plain" data-language="plain"><code>把 Stage 移动到 X=100, Y=50</code></pre>
<p id="ub1286871" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">Agent 可能会这样执行：</span></p>
<p id="u6511a841" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">第一步：</span></p>
<pre class="ne-codeblock language-plain" data-language="plain"><code>Thought: 需要先确认 Stage 是否已经 Home
Action: query_stage_status</code></pre>
<p id="u9451b732" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">第二步：</span></p>
<pre class="ne-codeblock language-plain" data-language="plain"><code>Observation: Stage 未 Home
Thought: 需要先执行 Home
Action: stage_home</code></pre>
<p id="u6c4c6d0a" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">第三步：</span></p>
<pre class="ne-codeblock language-plain" data-language="plain"><code>Observation: Stage 已 Home
Thought: 可以执行移动
Action: stage_move(100, 50)</code></pre>
<p id="u43e4b4df" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">第四步：</span></p>
<pre class="ne-codeblock language-plain" data-language="plain"><code>Observation: Stage 移动成功
Thought: 任务完成</code></pre>
<p id="u01266f31" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">如果把这个过程画出来，其实就是：</span></p>
<pre class="ne-codeblock language-plain" data-language="plain"><code>思考 → 行动 → 观察 → 再思考</code></pre>
<p id="ub81d17cf" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">这和 ReAct 的循环结构是完全一致的。</span></p>
<hr id="rswUg" class="ne-hr">
<h1 id="gIJCD"><span class="ne-text">所有 Agent 系统，本质都绕不开这个循环</span></h1>
<p id="u26241119" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">不管是：</span></p>
<ul class="ne-ul">
<li id="uf2dc0c52" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">LangGraph</span></li>
<li id="u03497437" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">AutoGen</span></li>
<li id="ua8ee1a11" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">CrewAI</span></li>
</ul>
<p id="u21672c87" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">底层其实都离不开这个结构。</span></p>
<p id="u1e87046a" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">差别只是在于：</span></p>
<p id="uc938b05e" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">有些系统在这个循环上增加了更多能力，比如：</span></p>
<ul class="ne-ul">
<li id="ub57fa4b8" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">Memory</span></li>
<li id="u59e493f4" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">Planning</span></li>
<li id="u2f5499d2" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">Multi-Agent</span></li>
<li id="u6c989831" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">Workflow</span></li>
</ul>
<p id="ucdf02a49" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">但如果把这些东西都拿掉，剩下的核心，其实还是这个 <strong>Agent Loop</strong><span class="ne-text">。</span></span></p>
</div>

</div>
